event_name: Date 19 July 2020 Time 15:52 2020 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 July 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 6 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe manner.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 55 was on the fast lane when car 6 was released from its pit station and touched car 55.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 6 Unsafe Release
